events: two finite reference realizations, no population nonidentifiability proof
E_event: Jeffreys0.5 marginal Bernoulli mean composite score, temp1, not joint independent likelihood
A1: mean reference native-map probability negative mean-square distance at447 cells; cannot distinguish distributions with same mean
continuous_B4: placeholder zeros excluded; no amplitude error claimed
MAP: raster density maximum can differ from maximum region mass because regions have unequal areas; all ties retained
N0: unchanged native adaptive histories projected onto coarse regions for bookkeeping; no same-head effect subtraction
coarse_source: continuous true source differs from geometry representative, paired models share this error
auxiliary: kept all finite values including physical support; not additional independent flight samples
